name: calf-raise-barbell-standing-rocking
title: Calf Raise: Barbell (Standing, Rocking)
primer: This exercise uses a simple rocking motion to strengthen the calves.
steps: Stand with a bar across your shoulders.
With your feet flat on the floor, lift your heels up and rock forward as if you are performing a calf raise.
Then "rock" back onto your heels so your toes are flexed and off the floor.
tips: Wear running or cross training shoes while performing this exercise.
Try performing this exercise without weight to become familiar with the movement.
